patterns.reason: deprecated MulticastSocket.joinGroup/leaveGroup(InetAddress) overload; JDK 17 moved multicast onto DatagramSocket

rule_description: JDK 17 (JDK-8237352) added joinGroup/leaveGroup to java.net.DatagramSocket and states that the MulticastSocket API 'works as before, although most of its methods are deprecated'. JADE's main-container discovery listener joins and leaves the multicast group through the two deprecated InetAddress overloads. Behaviour on 17 is unchanged -- this is a plain deprecation, not a removal and not a semantic change -- so the rule is LOW.
verification_hint: Recompiling on jade-ant:17 reports no '[deprecation] joinGroup(InetAddress)' or 'leaveGroup(InetAddress) in MulticastSocket' warnings. A two-container JADE platform still discovers its main container over multicast.
